  California Public Resources Code.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Mayor Pro Tem Farfan recused himself from Agenda Item No. A­1.

  Councilmember Roa recused himself from Agenda Item No. A­1.

2.  Recommendation to:
  1. Hold a public hearing to consider amendments to Hawaiian Gardens Municipal Code, Title
  18 of the Hawaiian Gardens Municipal Code (HGMC) modifying Section 18.80.010 (CC­
  Card Club Overlay Zone) and Section 18.80.040 (BC­ Bingo Club Overlay Zone) to allow
  electrical utility metering and service equipment for electric car charging systems within a
  landscape setback.
  2. Introduce, on first reading, the proposed ordinance approving text amendments to Title 18 of
  the HGMC modifying Section 18.80.010 (CC­ Card Club Overlay Zone) and Section
  18.80.040 (BC­ Bingo Club Overlay Zone) to allow electrical utility metering and service
  equipment for electric car charging systems within a landscape setback (Attachment “A”);
  and
  3. Determine the project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, spoke and provided a PowerPoint
  presentation.

  Wayne Brown, Hawaiian Gardens resident, spoke.

  Mayor Pro Tem Farfan spoke.
